selection.ownership: Laposta B.V., the Netherlands. Dutch/EU email-marketing SaaS with a public HTTPS API.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Laposta API docs (Basic auth, GET /v2/list, GET /v2/list/{list_id}, GET /v2/member, 401/429), security page, and dated incident search (Laposta + security breach/incident/datalek). No qualifying current unresolved Laposta compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official English docs set Default API URL to https://api.laposta.org/ with Basic Authentication (API key as username, empty password). GET /v2/list lists mailing lists; GET /v2/member?list_id= lists members. 401 is invalid API key; 429 sends Retry-After. Operator is Laposta B.V. (Netherlands). Pinned source used api.laposta.nl; native follows the official English Default API URL.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Laposta + security breach/incident/datalek found ISO 27001 security documentation and a customer-facing data-breach process article, not a disclosed current unresolved customer-data compromise. An Indonesian LAPOR! government-platform claim is a different product.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Official English Default API URL is https://api.laposta.org/; pinned source used https://api.laposta.nl. Native follows the official English host.
Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v2/list. Native category is email-marketing (source Marketing/Communication are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist).
Writes and form-encoded create/update bodies are omitted.
Returns raw Laposta JSON under data. Official GET /v2/list has no query parameters.
Official GET /v2/list/{list_id}. list_id is URI-encoded.
Official GET /v2/member requires list_id. Optional state is active, unsubscribed, or cleaned.
Official GET /v2/member/{member_id}?list_id={list_id}. member_id may be a member ID or email.
Pinned source double-encodes '+' in member emails as %252B. Native encodeURIComponent encodes '+' once as %2B; plus-address emails are therefore an explicit encoding adaptation.
Official POST /v2/list as application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Pinned source create_list is included.
Official POST /v2/list/{list_id}. Omitted fields keep their current values.
Official DELETE /v2/list/{list_id}. Not present in the pinned open-connector selection.
Official DELETE /v2/list/{list_id}/members. Not present in the pinned open-connector selection.
Official POST /v2/member. Nested custom_fields and options are flattened by a handwritten form encoder because declarative form bodies reject objects and arrays.
Official POST /v2/member/{member_id}. Nested custom_fields are flattened by the handwritten form encoder.
Official DELETE /v2/member/{member_id}?list_id=. Plus-address emails use encodeURIComponent (%2B), not the pinned %252B double-encode.
Official GET /v2/field?list_id=.
Official GET /v2/field/{field_id}?list_id=.
Official POST /v2/field. options[] is flattened by the handwritten form encoder.
Official POST /v2/field/{field_id} with JSON body so Composio options_full arrays are sent as documented.
Official DELETE /v2/field/{field_id}?list_id=.
Official GET /v2/segment?list_id=.
Official GET /v2/segment/{segment_id}?list_id=.
Official GET /v2/webhook?list_id=.
Official GET /v2/webhook/{webhook_id}?list_id=.
Official POST /v2/webhook. This is webhook subscription CRUD (sideEffect write), not an inbound AppCall trigger.
Official POST /v2/webhook/{webhook_id}. Webhook subscription CRUD, not an inbound trigger.
Official DELETE /v2/webhook/{webhook_id}?list_id=. Webhook subscription CRUD, not an inbound trigger.
Official GET /v2/campaign. No input parameters.
Official GET /v2/report. No input parameters.
